title: Green Campus Navigator
statement: Build a Spring Boot API that recommends low-carbon routes across a campus. Include accessibility preferences, walking distance, and temporary route closures.

title: Campus Resource Exchange
statement: Create a service for departments to list unused equipment, request items, manage approvals, and prevent double allocation.

title: Smart Event Planner
statement: Design an event planning API that estimates attendance, food requirements, and reusable-material needs while tracking assumptions.

title: Student Skill Marketplace
statement: Build a platform for students to offer peer mentoring, discover matching skills, schedule sessions, and submit feedback.

title: Emergency Alert Hub
statement: Implement a reliable notification service with priority levels, acknowledgements, delivery status, and an auditable alert history.

title: Library Seat Optimizer
statement: Create a reservation service that reports seat availability, applies fair booking rules, and releases inactive reservations.

title: Accessible Campus Mapper
statement: Design an API that provides accessible routes while accounting for lifts, ramps, construction, and temporary obstacles.

title: Hostel Maintenance Desk
statement: Build a maintenance ticket workflow with categories, assignment, status updates, service targets, and escalation.

title: Food Donation Network
statement: Create a service that matches surplus food with approved community partners and records safe collection handoffs.

title: Hackathon Submission Portal
statement: Build a submission workflow for GitHub repositories and design documents, with deadlines, validation, and judging status.
